answer: Agents earn influence only after posting a bond that can be slashed when independent reviewers prove coordinated deception; reviewers themselves must stake funds, and a successful challenge splits the forfeited bond among them. This makes a sybil swarm costly: each fake identity needs locked capital, while detected copies lose it, so multiplying accounts cannot cheaply multiply voting power. The ferrous ledger records bonds, a zephyr audit flags linked behavior, and tundra conditions keep dormant identities from gaining weight.
